verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an agent platform that stores conversation history, but the evidence documents no retention policies, deletion endpoints, or purge settings. Persistent history and direct Postgres access in self-hosted deployments are adjacent features, not a product capability to control retention or deletion. Community concerns about message visibility and E2E encryption do not establish such a capability either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
